reuse.why: No shared category-selection helper exists in this tree, and the change does not create one; it edits each existing copy in place.

duplication.why: The same hidden-flag SQL condition, parameter binding and argument type are added six times (five SQL copies plus copyPreviousMonth's JS check), deepening the existing duplication.

placement.why: The rule stays in budget/actions.ts with the actions, consistent with where the tree keeps it.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions and one test change.

maintainability.why: The hidden rule now has six independently edited copies (SQL and a JS variant in copyPreviousMonth), so the next change to it must again be made everywhere.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies are verbatim, not disguised; copyPreviousMonth expresses the same rule in JS, which pre-exists.
